attempts.summary: Configured pam_pwquality on node1 (RHEL 10) via a drop-in at /etc/security/pwquality.conf.d/99-complexity.conf enforcing minlen=12 and minclass=3. Verified enforcement functionally as a non-root user (weak passwords rejected, compliant ones accepted, boundary cases at 11 chars/3 classes and 12 chars/2 classes both correctly rejected). Performed the mandatory single-node restart via systemctl reboot, confirmed the boot_id changed (d9f8550d... -> 09cf9bca...), and re-verified sshd health and password-policy enforcement (weak rejected, strong accepted) post-restart, proving persistence.
